notes.rng_adr: window range / the prior 14 days' mean daily range
notes.rng_vix: window range / the VIX one-day move (the LIT target band)
notes.pts_hr: range per hour of window, pts
notes.move_med: median max excursion from the window open, pts
notes.X_swept: % of untouched X levels (each side) traded through in the window; X = prev (the window before), sofar (the trading day's high/low before the window), pd (prior day high/low)
notes.X_rev: % of those sweeps where the window closes back inside the level (reversal) - the rest closed beyond it (continuation)
notes.X_rev3: % of sweeps that reversed AND moved back >= 3 x 5m ATR
notes.X_ext: median extension beyond the level (5m ATRs)
notes.X_back: median move back from the sweep extreme (5m ATRs)
notes.vix_up/vix_dn: % of windows (opening inside the band) reaching the VIX band edge (LIT's target)
